header: Which service teams put it to work
subheadline: The platform started with refrigeration contractors and spread sideways from there. These four trades make up most of the 640 companies on it, and each of them bent the setup to fit their own rules.

items.title: Refrigeration and cooling
items.description: F-gas certification checked on every assignment, refrigerant logged per unit, and leak-test intervals that generate their own visits.

items.title: Lift and escalator servicing
items.description: Statutory inspection dates per unit, entrapment calls with their own 30-minute response clock, and a signed record for the building owner.

items.title: Building services and HVAC
items.description: Planned maintenance across a portfolio of sites, with caretaker contacts, key codes and access windows held per building.

items.title: Industrial equipment dealers
items.description: Warranty work separated from billable work the moment a job is closed, so the manufacturer claim and the customer invoice never mix.
